and.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM clinlims.type_of_sample WHERE description = 'Crachat/Expectoration'
SELECT count(*) FROM clinlims.test WHERE name = 'Microscopie - Frottis Coloration Gram - Polynucléaires'

changeSet.comment: Ré-associer Polynucléaires (Gram) au type d'échantillon Crachat/Expectoration
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.sampletype_test (id, sample_type_id, test_id) SELECT nextval('clinlims.sample_type_test_seq'), tos.id, t.id FROM clinlims.type_of_sample tos CROSS JOIN clinlims.test t WHERE tos.description = 'Crachat/Expectoration' AND t.name = 'Microscopie - Frottis Coloration Gram - Polynucléaires' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.sampletype_test st WHERE st.sample_type_id = tos.id AND st.test_id = t.id );

changeSet.author: pkomena

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM clinlims.unit_of_measure WHERE name = 'num/champ'

changeSet.comment: Fixer l'unité 'num/champ' pour Polynucléaires (Gram) et Hématies/Leucocytes des Sécrétions vaginales
changeSet.sql: UPDATE clinlims.test SET uom_id = (SELECT id FROM clinlims.unit_of_measure WHERE name = 'num/champ' LIMIT 1), lastupdated = now() WHERE name IN ( 'Microscopie - Frottis Coloration Gram - Polynucléaires', 'Microscopie - Etat frais Quantitatif - Sécrétion vaginale - Hématies', 'Microscopie - Etat frais Quantitatif - Sécrétion vaginale - Leucocytes' );
